description: Search Shellui tools with a short phrase. Returns the best matches with read, write, destructive, and approval flags plus the full input schema, so you can call a match immediately. Optional filters: service (identity, storage, hosting, email) and access (read or write). limit defaults to 8. Then call the tool, or pass it to ai_call_tool.

access.description: Optional. read keeps read-only tools. write keeps tools that change data.

limit.description: How many matches to return. Default 8, maximum 20.

query.description: What you want to do, or an exact tool name.

service.description: Optional service id: identity, storage, hosting, email, or saas.

name: ai_search_tools
title: AI: Search tools

description: Return the full input schema, access flags, and a short usage note for one or more Shellui gateway tool names. Use this when a search result is not enough. Then call the tool directly or through ai_call_tool.

name.description: One tool name. Use names when you need more than one.

names.description: Gateway tool names, for example identity_list_users.

name: ai_describe_tool
title: AI: Describe tool

description: Run any Shellui gateway tool by name. arguments are the same object you would pass to tools/call. Tenant scope, approvals, secret masking, and audit logging are identical to a direct call. In ask mode the person sees the real tool name and arguments, not ai_call_tool.

arguments.description: Arguments for that tool. Use the input schema from search or describe.

name.description: Gateway tool name, for example identity_create_invitations.

name: ai_call_tool
title: AI: Call tool
